Class BookArrayUtils

java.lang.Object
edu.cssd2101.lab01.BookArrayUtils
public final class BookArrayUtils extends Object
Pure sparse-array operations except explicitly named in-place sorts.

Null array references are rejected; null slots are skipped or sorted last. Filtering is compact and preserves encounter order.
